description: This file defines a template class StreamJSONType within the Thunder::Core namespace, implementing a JSON stream handler with serialization and deserialization capabilities, including internal classes for managing serialization, deserialization, and data handling. It provides an interface for linking, sending, receiving, and managing JSON data streams, with support for different source types, allocators, and interfaces.

classes.name: StreamJSONType
classes.description: A template class providing JSON stream handling with serialization/deserialization, link management, and data flow control within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of interface data, managing a queue and locking for thread safety.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of incoming data streams, creating interface objects and passing them to the parent.

classes.name: HandlerType
classes.description: A handler class inheriting from SOURCE, managing data transmission and reception, and signaling state changes.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a reference to the linked source object.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle received interface elements.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send interface elements.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle state changes.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an interface element for transmission if the channel is open.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the data channel, waiting for a specified time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the data channel, waiting for a specified time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the channel is suspended.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks if both serializer and deserializer are idle.
